milestone: Lean-AHR v3.5 ProofNet translation repair bridge
changes: Opened Lean topology notation scope so ProofNet statements using 𝓝 parse under Mathlib.

Added verified Lean3/mathlib3-to-Lean4 normalizations for CompleteSpace, Dense, Monotone, TopologicalSpace.generateFrom, TendstoUniformly, IsClosedMap, connectedComponent, CountablyCompactSpace, and TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis cleanup.
Removed the over-broad unsupported token filter, which incorrectly marked translated Filter.Tendsto statements as unsupported.

interpretation.translation_change: Translation and retrieval coverage improved by 7 rows, from 26/50 to 33/50.
interpretation.solve_rate_change: Verified target proofs stayed flat at 5/50.
interpretation.cost_change: Lean calls increased from 537 to 697 because more previously unparsed rows now run the full proof-attempt budget.
interpretation.frontier_shift: The bottleneck moved from translation parsing toward proof-script synthesis for translated analysis/topology targets.

next_step: Build a failure-aware proof-script expansion pass for the 28 translated verification failures, starting with the newly translated 𝓝/Tendsto rows and dense/monotone/topology-generation rows.
